theme.name: Sci-Fi
theme.style: Modern sci-fi collectible-card key art in a CG and comic-book hybrid style: painterly volumetric rendering carried by clean comic ink weight on the silhouette, cinematic and high-craft, the way a premium video game paints its collectible cards. Cyan and teal key light rakes the subject from one side, a hard cyan rim light separates it from a deep blue-black background, and soft atmospheric haze falls away behind. One strong centered focal shape, isolated, uncluttered edges, nothing in the background competing with it, and it still reads at thumbnail size. Square composition with generous breathing room. Artwork only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable symbols, no UI labels, no card frame.

craft.C: Context. A vast dark situation table where a holographic terrain of the problem resolves out of nothing, a bounded pool of cyan light defining exactly how far the known world extends and open shadow beyond its edge.
craft.R: Role. A rank of identical armored crew silhouettes standing in shadow while one steps forward into full cyan key light, its specialist gear catching the beam, the chosen perspective made physical.
craft.A: Action. The moment of commitment: a heavy mechanism driving forward along a rail, thrust light blooming behind it, energy discharging in a decisive forward vector across the frame.
craft.F: Format. A precision mold closing around molten luminous material and pressing it into one exact geometric form, a clean shaped artifact emerging from formless glow.
craft.T: Target audience. A single figure seen from behind at a wide viewport, lit from the front by the transmission arriving for them, the whole scene built around who is receiving it.

roles.researcher: A xenoarchivist in a modular field rig, half-lit by the cracked data-core she is coaxing back to life, spectral survey planes and annotated star-charts hovering around her hands as she traces one thread back to its origin.
roles.analyst: An analyst standing inside a suspended lattice of readings, pulling two conflicting data strands apart with both hands so the pattern between them resolves, outlier points burning brighter than the rest.
roles.strategist: A campaign strategist over a darkened war table, three glowing approach vectors projected above it, one hand hovering to commit while the others dim, distant terrain rendered in wireframe.
roles.historian: A chronicler at a towering memory spindle, drawing a single luminous timeline thread out of a vault of stacked archive cores, older layers dimmer and deeper behind.
roles.fact-checker: A verification officer holding a claim slab in an authentication clamp, provenance beams shooting from it toward distant source cores, some locking solid and others flickering unresolved.
roles.synthesizer: A signal weaver at a braiding loom, gathering many separate glowing data strands into a single coherent cable, the incompatible strands left visibly standing apart.
roles.explainer-educator: An instructor unfolding a complex mechanism into a floating exploded diagram, the pieces separating in mid-air along clean cyan guide-lines, one hand steadying the sequence.
roles.comparative-reviewer: A critical reviewer between two suspended prototypes in an inspection bay, stress beams probing both, hairline stress-fractures glowing where each one is weakest.
roles.developer: An engineer wrist-deep in a modular lattice of interlocking components, seating one new part into place while the surrounding structure lights up to accept it.
roles.technical-troubleshooter: A diagnostics technician tracing a fault arc through a machine's exposed guts, one glowing break in an otherwise dark circuit, probe held steady at the exact point of failure.
roles.systems-designer: A systems architect inside a hovering orbital schematic, moving whole subsystems into relation with each other, data flows drawn as light between them.
roles.workflow-architect: A pipeline designer above a conveyor of light, rerouting a stalled segment so the flow runs clean, the old bottleneck dark and bypassed beside it.
roles.ux-ui-advisor: An interface ergonomist testing a control surface with a gloved hand, heat-bloom showing where the reach is awkward, a cleaner layout ghosted over the old one.
roles.data-analyst: A data diver suspended in a dense particle field of measurements, cupping a cluster where the signal concentrates, sparse noise drifting away at the edges.
roles.qa-test-engineer: A stress-test operator deliberately driving a prototype past its limits inside a reinforced bay, the exact failure point flaring bright as the structure gives.
roles.security-reviewer: A breach analyst probing a shield lattice from outside, one hairline seam in the barrier lighting up under the probe, the rest of the wall holding dark and solid.
roles.writer: A composer at a text-loom, drawing a single clean line of luminous thread out of raw formless material, the finished passage hanging in ordered rows behind.
roles.editor: An editor over a manuscript slab with a precision cutting tool, lifting away excess material in clean slivers, the strong original structure left standing and lit.
roles.copywriter: A signal-caster tuning a broadcast pod down to one sharp focused beam, the wide scattered transmission collapsing into a single bright directional lance.
roles.rewriter: A reforge specialist melting a bent component and recasting it in a cleaner mold, the original shape ghosted alongside so the meaning is visibly preserved.
roles.pitch-strategist: A presenter at the head of a dark hall commanding a rising arc of light from problem to proof, incoming objection-bolts breaking against it as it climbs.
roles.presentation-slide-structurer: A deck builder sequencing floating stage panels into a single ordered run, each panel holding one clear shape, the sequence receding into the dark.
roles.creative-director: A creative director at a rig projecting several genuinely different directions at once, each a distinct silhouette, one hand raised toward the boldest.
roles.concept-developer: A concept smith growing a raw luminous seed into a structured form inside a shaping chamber, the hook of the idea crystallizing hard and bright at its center.
roles.brainstorming-partner: An idea generator releasing a swarm of divergent spark-drones from an open case, each one a different shape, the strongest few already clustering together.
roles.prompt-engineer: A prompt-smith tuning a glowing instruction core on a calibration bench, ambiguity venting off as dark vapor while the core settles into a clean stable pulse.
roles.tutor: A patient tutor guiding a learner's hand onto the next rung of a rising ladder of light, the rungs already climbed still glowing warm behind them.
roles.curriculum-designer: A curriculum designer laying a sequenced path of platforms across a dark gap, each platform locking into the last, checkpoint beacons marking mastery.
roles.mentor: A veteran mentor beside a younger figure at a high overlook, pointing out one specific route through the terrain below rather than the whole horizon.
roles.consultant: A consultant at a client's situation table, sweeping away clutter to leave one clearly lit recommended path, discarded alternatives dimmed at the table edge.
roles.product-strategist: A product strategist weighing glowing opportunity masses on a suspended scale, one pan clearly heavier and lit, the rejected mass set aside in shadow.
roles.market-positioning-advisor: A positioning strategist plotting a claim-marker into open unoccupied space on a category map, rival markers clustered and crowded elsewhere on the field.
roles.product-manager: A product manager triaging a queue of incoming work slabs, pulling three forward into the lit build lane and holding the rest back behind a barrier.
roles.summarizer: A compression operator feeding a towering volume of material into a distillation press and drawing out one dense luminous shard that holds all of its weight.
roles.organizer: An organizer standing in drifting unsorted debris, snapping the pieces into a clean filing lattice, the empty cells where things are missing left visibly dark.

lineages.context-exclusions: A diverter gate splitting an incoming stream, sending one branch cleanly away into a sealed dark channel while the approved flow continues lit.
lineages.action-inspect: A magnifier probe hovering over an opened assembly, sweeping its beam across the parts and catching one loose connection glinting out of alignment.
lineages.action-analyze: A separation column pulling a single mixed signal apart into distinct luminous strata, causes settling into layered bands, one anomalous band burning brighter.
lineages.action-compare: A twin-pan balance suspended in the dark holding two artifacts against the same measuring beam, the tipping difference clearly readable in its tilt.
lineages.action-create: A fabricator arm assembling a finished form out of drifting component parts, the artifact taking shape in a bloom of cyan construction light.
lineages.action-recommend: A selector mechanism committing to one of several branching rails, the chosen track lighting up bright and continuous while the others go dark.
lineages.action-verify: A test rig running a finished component through a gauntlet of measuring gates, each gate lighting green as it passes, one gate still probing hard.
lineages.action-summarize: A compression press reducing a tall stack of material into one dense bright wafer, the original volume ghosted behind at its true scale.
lineages.action-research: A deep-scan array fanning search beams into surrounding darkness, one distant return signal locking in bright while weaker returns fade.
lineages.action-plan: A sequencer laying ordered nodes along a track, dependency lines drawn between them, the next executable node lit and the blocked ones dimmed.
lineages.action-ideate: A spark chamber throwing off many genuinely different forms at once, no two alike, a few of the strongest already drifting together into a cluster.
lineages.action-explain: An exploded-view projector unfolding a mechanism in mid-air, the parts separating along clean guide-lines so the workings between them become visible.

lineages.format-key-points: A rack of separated point-shards standing in a row, each one distinct and evenly lit, clear dark gaps holding them apart.
lineages.format-summary: A distillation vessel with the heaviest conclusion settled bright at the top and the supporting sediment layered below it in shadow.
lineages.format-sections: A segmented column of stacked chambers, each chamber a distinct sealed volume with its own internal glow, the divisions between them crisp.
lineages.format-evidence: Anchor lines running from a floating claim down to solid source cores below, each line taut and lit, one unanchored claim drifting loose.
lineages.format-comparison: A grid lattice aligning several items along the same measuring axes, the intersections where they diverge flaring brighter than the rest.
lineages.format-next: A launch rail with ordered ready-markers lit in sequence, the first one primed and glowing hot, the later ones waiting cooler down the line.
lineages.format-length: A precision caliper clamped around a body of luminous material, compressing it to an exact marked width, the trimmed excess venting away as vapor.
lineages.format-tiers: A stepped platform descending into the dark, the top step small and brilliantly lit, each lower step wider and dimmer with supporting depth.
lineages.target-language: A translator prism stepping a dense beam down through graded facets, the light emerging simpler and clearer at each stage without losing its color.
lineages.target-voice: A tone modulator with a resonating fork held in a field of register bands, the selected band ringing bright and steady across its whole length.
lineages.target-examples: A projector casting small concrete miniature scenes into the air beneath a large abstract form, the miniatures sharp where the abstraction is vague.
lineages.target-decisions: A decision console of weighted levers, each one linked by a taut line to the consequence it triggers further down the board.
lineages.target-stance: A stance dial set between a warm amber pole and a hard cold pole, the needle locked firmly at a chosen point and the chosen temperature washing the scene.
